title: Call Between Alexey Navalny and FSB Officer Konstantin Kudryavtsev [English Subtitles]
summary: Bellingcat's publication of the recorded call in which Alexey Navalny, posing as a security aide, gets FSB officer Konstantin Kudryavtsev to describe the operation to poison him. It has English subtitles.
why: HN cites it as a striking confession obtained through caller ID spoofing and social engineering.

quote.text: But the best part is how he did it: caller ID spoof + social engineering.
